title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Tier Priced on a Re-Charge Span
content:
**Tier pricing note, resumed months — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The re-charge tier — the tier whose daily rate prices the re-charge span — follows where the resident lives now.

- Where the agreement records a move to another tier dated before the conversion date recorded on the agreement, and carries no isolation placement: the agreement's own tier, the resident living in that room now and the payer-conversion credit having given the advance back.
- Where the agreement carries an isolation placement: the isolation billing tier of the agreement's tier.
- Otherwise: the tier the advance was posted for.

| Agreement's tier | Its isolation billing tier |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |

**Points of judgement.** A move recorded on or after the recorded conversion date does not change the re-charge tier under the first rule. A move recorded before it, with no isolation placement, does.
